notes: cics-crucible commarea-mismatch / ca-xctl-versions (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): CAXB, the version-2 target of the crucible's XCTL, entered with the COMMAREA lengths its three callers produce (0, 10, 80) and the PF3 end. CAXA is not in this case: its XCTL passes a WORKING-STORAGE item, which the harness cannot describe as a COMMAREA class. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: direct-entry
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: every V2 field defaulted (and still labelled UPGRADED FROM V1)

scenarios.name: short-upgrade-10
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 10 (< LENGTH OF WS-V2): the first 10 bytes copied, the rest defaulted, version stamped 2

scenarios.name: full-80
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 80: the whole version-2 area copied
